title: Dependency compatibility and tracked container inputs

Active dependency contract enforces real inputs, effective check bindings, complete routed hashed handoffs and failure paths.
Legacy and real Copier upgrade compatibility preserve catalogs, project files and activation gates.
Real tracked source Dockerfile and dependency documents are linked, checked and validated by container build/smoke.
Required deterministic checks and trusted predecessor validation pass.
Independent plan, two Full reviews, triage and necessary Delta reviews close confirmed findings.
PR tree verified and visible Codex review requested; CI/results and limitations recorded.

manual_evidence: Git-tracked required files and remote PR-tree byte identity
Visible Codex review trigger/results and actual CI status; no native client discovery claim

stop_conditions: Failed required check without resolved diagnosis
Unexpected overwrite or weakening of local policy
forbidden_actions: Downstream writes or repository setting mutations
